recommendation: Keep the no-change audit as-is. If rendered Timing Structure tables still fail to expose BackboneType clearly, handle that separately under FHIR-50466/tooling or work-group review rather than changing Timing back to BackboneElement.
issue_request: FHIR-17108 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 correction reporting that the Datatypes page identified Timing as derived from BackboneElement, but the Timing detail/structure view showed the base as Element. The accepted resolution was to fix that mismatch.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-17108 was found. The same Timing hierarchy defect was applied through the tightly related FHIR-17403/GF#17403 trail: commit ada2e0c9c1c1d9f55da7212a82d639e2dad4832f changed the Timing spreadsheet root type from Structure to BackboneElement, and Grahame later commented "already done" on FHIR-17108.
additional_context: The current build source no longer uses the STU3 literal BackboneElement model for datatype roots that carry modifierExtension. Commit cbdf7d1e55dc4bfa1dc30fc526edee0491e05782 introduced BackboneType and changed Timing from BackboneElement to BackboneType. FHIR-17403 has already been audited on the combined branch, FHIR-26878 later treats Timing as a BackboneType-derived datatype, and unresolved FHIR-50466 plus the committers Zulip thread describe a separate rendered Structure-table display concern rather than a final source-edit decision for this seed.
reconciliation: This audit made no source edits. Current source/fhir.ini keeps Timing and BackboneType in active normative build scope; source/datatypes/timing.xml uses BackboneType for Timing; source/datatypes/backbonetype.xml defines BackboneType as the DataType-derived base for datatypes that can carry modifierExtension; and source/types.html reserves BackboneElement for elements inside resource definitions.
